skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply macroeconomic theories and models to analyze and evaluate the impact of global events on open economies.
Analyze and evaluate the effects of economic policies and shocks on macroeconomic stability.
Evaluate the benefits and costs of globalization for open economies.
Understand and analyze exchange rate determination in both short and long term.
Conduct independent research on international macroeconomic issues and crises.
Work effectively in groups to solve economic problems and present findings.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate economic policies and global financial crises.
Develop skills to present economic analysis and policy recommendations effectively.
Understand the impact of financial globalization on economies.
